main_text.head: Nauclerus naue perfossa sese cum suis & ipsa naue submergens.
XXXIX.
main_text.p: [Woodcut illustration of a ship with sailors, a ship's pilot, and a rocky coast; no text.]
INSanum hunc quicunque vides, seseque suósque, Rate perforata mergere, Ah, quam vera vides! nam quod pictum aspicis, horum Viua est imago temporum.

page.notes: The first letter of the verse is a large woodcut initial "I" (printed as "I" with the rest "NSanum"); the verse is set with long-s forms, transcribed as plain s. The illustration is described, not transcribed. Faint show-through text at right margin is omitted.
